name: Princess Vanilla
source:
A motherly princess. She is kind and gentle.

Rumor has it that she is unexpectedly fierce in various ways.

She is from Carnation Country.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/himebo/chara/chara.html]official site[/url]]
